rm -rf /tmp/t && mkdir -p /tmp/t && echo probe-dir-ready
echo  >> /tmp/t/harness.c.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/harness.c.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/harness.c && rm /tmp/t/harness.c.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/harness.c
echo  >> /tmp/t/os_cfg.h.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/os_cfg.h.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/os_cfg.h && rm /tmp/t/os_cfg.h.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/os_cfg.h
echo  >> /tmp/t/os_cfg.c.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/os_cfg.c.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/os_cfg.c && rm /tmp/t/os_cfg.c.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/os_cfg.c
echo  >> /tmp/t/gold.c.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/gold.c.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/gold.c && rm /tmp/t/gold.c.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/gold.c
echo  >> /tmp/t/naive_a.c.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/naive_a.c.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/naive_a.c && rm /tmp/t/naive_a.c.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/naive_a.c
echo  >> /tmp/t/naive_b.c.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/naive_b.c.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/naive_b.c && rm /tmp/t/naive_b.c.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/naive_b.c
echo  >> /tmp/t/naive_c.c.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/naive_c.c.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/naive_c.c && rm /tmp/t/naive_c.c.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/naive_c.c
echo  >> /tmp/t/comment_main.c.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/comment_main.c.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/comment_main.c && rm /tmp/t/comment_main.c.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/comment_main.c
echo  >> /tmp/t/evil.c.b64 && base64 -d /tmp/t/evil.c.b64 | gunzip > /tmp/t/evil.c && rm /tmp/t/evil.c.b64 && sha256sum /tmp/t/evil.c
for f in os_cfg gold naive_a naive_b naive_c comment_main evil; do cp /tmp/t/$f.c /app/solution.c; echo "== $f"; gcc -O2 -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -I/tmp/t -o /tmp/prog /tmp/t/harness.c /app/solution.c -lm && /tmp/prog | grep -v "^info_[mr]_"; done
cp /tmp/t/gold.c /app/solution.c && mkdir -p /tmp/src && cp /tmp/t/os_cfg.h /tmp/src/ && gcc -O2 -std=c11 -Wall -I/tmp/src -c /app/solution.c -o /tmp/sol.o && echo prompt-compile-ok
cp /tmp/t/os_cfg.c /app/solution.c && gcc -O2 -std=c11 -I/tmp/t -o /tmp/prog /tmp/t/harness.c /app/solution.c -lm && /tmp/prog | grep "^info_"
